Usage: actual transactions add [options]

Add transactions to an account

Options:
  --account <id>      Account ID
  --data <json>       Transaction data as JSON array
  --file <path>       Read transaction data from JSON file (use - for stdin)
  --learn-categories  Learn category assignments (default: false)
  --run-transfers     Process transfers (default: false)
  -h, --help          display help for command
